name: LaDoger music library
description: Legally usable music (PD / CC0 / CC BY, flagged otherwise) for commercial and social video. Relative paths resolve against pages_base; every *_url field here is already absolute.

licence_status_meaning.clean: PD / CC0 / PDM / US-gov recording and score. Commercial use, no credit needed (courtesy credit still listed where the source asks).
licence_status_meaning.attribution: CC BY somewhere in the row. Commercial use OK with the credit line in the post / video description.
licence_status_meaning.sharealike: CC BY-SA or OAL somewhere in the row. Remixes may have to carry the same licence. Check recording_status vs score_status: often only one part is affected.
licence_status_meaning.flagged: Known caveat (territorial term, arrangement, retired PD dedication). Read legal_notes before publishing.
licence_status_meaning.unverified: Rights not confirmed from the source page. Do not publish without checking.
